newsitem.title: FRANCE: Presidency denies Chirac to speak May 7.
newsitem.headline: Presidency denies Chirac to speak May 7.

text.p: The French presidential palace denied on Saturday that President Jacques Chirac would intervene in the country's general election campaign on Wednesday.

A spokeswoman for the presidency said there was no truth in a report in the daily newspaper Le Figaro saying Chirac would speak to mark the second anniversary of his election and simultaneously back centre-right parties in the campaign.
Reports Chirac would intervene in the campaign have circulated for several days. Polls now show the centre-right favoured to win the May 25-June 1 votes.
